summary: Frontend-only PASS at https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). All 3 NEW Weather features and every regression check pass. (1) NEW Alert detail modal: with ZIP 77002 set on Flights tab, the Weather 'Active Alerts' card shows the 'Tap for details ›' hint (visible at bottom of the alert card next to the expiry). Tapping the alert card opens a bottom-sheet Modal with the severity color bar, event title 'Heat Advisory', 'Moderate · until Wed 12:00 AM' meta, area 'Houston, Trinity +31 more', a headline paragraph, a 'DETAILS' section with the full NWS description, and a 'WHAT TO DO' section with the instruction. The modalBody ScrollView is actually scrollable (measured scrollHeight=992, clientHeight=584, scrollTop moved 0->300 successfully) so the long WHAT TO DO section is reachable. The close X (top-right, 36x36 hitbox at ~(360,200)) dismisses the modal cleanly and returns to the Weather screen with no crash and no pageerrors. (2) NEW County line: with ZIP 77002, a compact line 'Harris County, TX · Houston' appears at the top of the Weather body (below the hero, above ACTIVE ALERTS), rendered as an Ionicons navigate-circle + text. Also verified for 94103 -> shows 'San Francisco County, CA · San Francisco'. Failure path is tolerated: locationInfo() returns null on any error and the conditional render `located && (locInfo?.county || locInfo?.city)` prevents crashes. (3) NEW Alert Chime toggle: 'Alert Chime' card with bell icon appears below 'Time & Temperature'. Toggling it flips localStorage aura_settings_v1 -> weather.alertSound from false to true; after a full page reload the toggle stays ON and localStorage still shows weather.alertSound=true. Audio playback itself is native-only (expo-audio) and not testable in web preview - noted as by-design. (4) REGRESSION Weather: Active Alerts still list ABOVE the master toggle, severity colors correct (Heat Advisory yellow/Moderate), 'No active alerts for your area.' clear-state renders at ZIP 94103, 'Time & Temperature' toggle still persists, all four 'Minimum Severity' radios still visible with the correct one highlighted (Severe by default), and 'Preview Alert on Matrix' shows the exact info toast 'Connect to the matrix first (Device tab).' when BLE is disconnected. (5) REGRESSION overall: All 4 tabs (Device/Flights/Sports/Weather) load without red-screen. Flights ZIP geocode still renders 'Houston, TX · 29.759, -95.359'. Global SYNC FAB shows an info toast 'BLE needs a real device build to sync.' when disconnected. No new deprecation warnings beyond the long-standing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver notes carried over from iter 8-14.

issues: No testIDs on the new elements. Suggested for the next iteration: weather-county-line, weather-alert-card, weather-alert-modal, weather-alert-modal-close, weather-alert-chime-toggle. Not a functional bug.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx and shared Card component.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' fires when Toast animates. Could be gated behind Platform.OS !== 'web'. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, repeat) Add testID props to Weather elements: weather-county-line, weather-alert-card, weather-alert-modal, weather-alert-modal-close, weather-alert-chime-toggle. Currently tests locate elements by visible text and DOM heuristics, which is fragile.

(Optional) buildFullPayload / updateWeather livePush do NOT include weather.alertSound in the payload sent to the matrix (see /app/frontend/src/store/matrix.tsx:153-157 and :290-294). This is INTENTIONAL for now because alertSound is a phone-side feature, but consider a code comment to make that explicit so a future dev doesn't assume it should sync to the matrix.
(Repeated from iter 8-14) Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents in SyncFab.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: weather.tsx:51 useAudioPlayer(require('@/assets/sounds/alert.wav')) - asset exists at /app/frontend/assets/sounds/alert.wav. Player is created at mount; play() is wrapped in try/catch so web preview failures are swallowed. Good.
weather.tsx:48-50 seenIdsRef + firstLoadRef correctly seed known alerts silently on the first load and only chime on brand-new Severe/Extreme alerts on subsequent polls. Ordering is correct.
weather.tsx:84-92 useEffect resets firstLoadRef and seenIdsRef whenever lat/lon changes so a ZIP switch does not misfire the chime on old-alerts-that-are-new-to-this-ZIP. Correct.
weather.tsx:94-97 second useEffect calls locationInfo() only when located; the .then(setLocInfo) accepts null on failure and the conditional render handles null safely.
weather.tsx:142-160 Pressable wraps the entire alert card with Haptics.selectionAsync() + setDetail(a). Modal is rendered once outside the map so re-mounts don't happen per card.

weather.tsx:262-312 AlertDetailModal uses transparent React Native Modal with animationType='slide' and onRequestClose - proper Android back-button handling. Sheet has maxHeight 82% and its inner ScrollView (line 289) IS the scroll region for the long description (verified programmatically: sh=992 > ch=584).

weather.ts:98-141 locationInfo() has a 24h in-memory cache keyed by lat.toFixed(3)/lon.toFixed(3), 8s AbortController timeout, and swallows the county-zone fetch failure independently so a broken county lookup still returns city/state. Robust.
weather.ts:44-86 activeAlerts() now also returns id/description/instruction as per the type; still de-dupes by event+area and sorts by SEV_RANK. Good.

matrix.tsx:47 & 78 Settings type + DEFAULT_SETTINGS both include weather.alertSound:false, hydration merges saved values via {...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.weather, ...(saved.weather ?? {})} so pre-existing users get the new field defaulted safely.
matrix.tsx:285-299 updateWeather persists alertSound via persist(next) but livePush only ships enabled/severity/showClock to BLE. Intentional (phone-side only). Consider a one-line code comment.
